clips.label: The Glass Tide · 8 seconds
clips.note: A bank around crimson coral leads into a violet spiral and through the reef.
clips.details: Starts with the exact approved coral-ring still. Continuous bank, sideways travel, regional curling and a diagonal sweep beneath the violet overhang. Krea 2 Turbo, Euler at noise 0.72, three updates, CFG1; each frame starts from the warped previous painting. Additional reference conditioning is off after a matched opening comparison. Every painting is retained in the 24 fps delivery; RIFE stays outside feedback. No cuts, masks or extra detail pass. Fine coral branching simplifies during recurrence.
